name: file_extensions
description: Supply conventional dot-prefixed file extensions for programming and structured-data file types; matched controls copy the filename stem.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
types={'Python source':'.py','JavaScript source':'.js','HTML page':'.html','CSS stylesheet':'.css','JSON data':'.json','XML document':'.xml','Markdown document':'.md','C source':'.c','C++ source':'.cpp','Java source':'.java','TypeScript source':'.ts','Bash shell script':'.sh'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 kind=list(types)[i%len(types)];stem=random.choice(['main','sample','report','example','module','document','source','test']);p=f'File stem: {stem}. File type: {kind}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only its conventional file extension, including the dot. Answer:','answer':' '+types[kind]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only its file stem, without an extension. Answer:','answer':' '+stem})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
